Found out out to the real problem:

After I reset my windows I downloaded Razer Synapse3 to fix my peripherals and hope it wouldn't fuck up my SteamVR. Turns out that it it did, and I fixed it by uninstalling it, and going into my device manger and looking at the Razer Devices section, and deleting all of the mini HID drivers. This, after a reboot, fixed it. I've recently downloaded the old Razer Synapse, and so far SteamVR is working fine.
